intended_object: Base change of a submersive presentation. Given a submersive presentation of the R-algebra S, with generators ι and relations σ, and an R-algebra T, it gives the induced submersive presentation of T ⊗[R] S over T, with the same generators and relations. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
The definition reuses the base-changed pre-submersive presentation, which has the same generators and relations and the same `map`; the relations are those of P with their coefficients pushed along R → T. The new Jacobian is `1 ⊗ₜ P.jacobian` (lemma `baseChange_jacobian`, line 420 of the same file). It is a unit because `includeRight` is a ring homomorphism and ring homomorphisms send units to units.

This is the standard construction, stated in full generality: T is any commutative R-algebra, and ι and σ are arbitrary, with σ finite as the notion of a submersive presentation requires. The declaration is Mathlib's own, so no other Mathlib declaration covers the same object, and nothing is missing.
